description: Marketer redeems the one-time invite token and sets a password (does not sign in).

body.message: Password set. You can now sign in.

note: Email delivery is NOT exercised live. The one-time token was read straight out of Redis (set marketer_invite:<token>, indexed by marketer_tokens:<marketer id>), exactly where TokenService.create_marketer_invite_token stores it, instead of from an email link. The value is redacted here.
